instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Specialized facade engineering contractor designing and installing curtain wall systems, structural glazing, and rainscreen cladding for high-rise office towers. Deep expertise in EN 13830 compliance and thermal performance modeling. Exploring parametric design tools to accelerate shop drawing generation. Operate from 2-3 locations or departments. We have some budget headroom for experimentation but look for quick wins that can demonstrate value within 6 months before committing to longer-term programs. The leadership team is aligned on the need to modernize but debates where to start.
answers.pastInitiatives: We have a mature innovation program with a dedicated R&D lab of 12 engineers, an annual innovation budget equivalent to 5% of revenue, and a structured stage-gate process for evaluating and funding new initiatives. In the past 3 years we have launched 4 new product lines that now contribute 18% of total revenue, including an AI-powered recommendation engine that has become our fastest-growing SKU.
answers.strategicGoals: We are heavily dependent on a single product category and a concentrated customer base — our top 3 clients represent 55% of revenue. This concentration risk is unacceptable for our long-term health. We need to identify and develop new revenue streams, possibly including new product lines for different customer segments or entirely new business models that leverage our existing capabilities.

input.changes_since_last: Supply chain disruptions affected 8 product lines. Inventory digitalization project launched. Margins under pressure.

opportunities.title: Developing a Multi-Segment Diversification Roadmap
opportunities.rationale: The high reliance on the top three clients (55% of revenue) presents an unacceptable concentration risk. This opportunity shifts focus from optimizing current product lines to actively identifying and validating new, resilient revenue streams in adjacent sectors or geographies.

first_actions: Conduct a deep dive market analysis on 3 non-core industries (e.g., sustainable infrastructure, healthcare facilities) where facade expertise is transferable.
Establish an internal 'Opportunity Scouting' task force composed of engineers and sales staff to interview subject matter experts outside the current customer base.
Develop low-fidelity business model canvases for at least two promising new segments.
resources_needed: Dedicated time from senior sales/engineering leadership (20% allocation)
Small budget for market validation interviews ($50k)
execution_plan.success_metric: Identification and preliminary feasibility scoring of 3 distinct new revenue segments, with a defined target customer profile for each.
milestones: Pilot B2B concept validation with potential non-client partners (Month 3)
Formalized proposal for the highest scoring segment to the leadership team (Month 6)

opportunities.title: Building a Modular 'Capability Library' for Accelerating New Offerings
opportunities.rationale: To accelerate diversification, Strato must package its deep expertise (e.g., thermal modeling, parametric design) into reusable, modular service offerings that can be quickly adapted for different client segments without starting from scratch.

first_actions: Audit existing R&D assets and proprietary knowledge bases to define 5 core, discrete technical modules (e.g., Parametric Facade Simulation Module).
Develop internal playbooks detailing the minimum viable product (MVP) needed to sell each module externally.
Pilot the use of one capability module with an existing client in a non-core area to test market acceptance.
execution_plan.success_metric: Creation of 5 documented, marketable 'Capability Modules' and a measurable decrease in the time required to scope new product proposals by 20%.
milestones: Internal training and SOP creation for sales/engineering on module usage (Month 4)
Successful internal pitch presentation demonstrating module value (Month 6)

next_steps.action: Hold a risk mitigation workshop focused solely on the top 3 clients' dependency. Identify explicit contractual or operational steps to reduce single-client revenue exposure over the next fiscal year.
Structure and fund a 'Diversification Seed Budget' specifically earmarked for external market research and concept validation, ring-fencing it from core operations budgets.
Formalize cross-departmental knowledge transfer sessions to ensure technical expertise (e.g., thermal modeling) is documented and accessible, mitigating talent risk.

key_weaknesses: High revenue concentration risk due to dependency on the top three client accounts (55% of total revenue).
Potential for process silos across different physical locations, hindering seamless scaling of new offerings.
Internal debate regarding prioritization—the leadership team is aligned on modernization but needs clear segmentation guidance to start.

improvements: Digital capabilities have significantly matured (D-Maturity 3 -> 4), evidenced by the launch of inventory digitalization.
The formal innovation structure is robust, demonstrated by the successful launch and growth of AI-powered SKUs; this confirms process maturity.
A proactive budget allocation (7% percentage) indicates increased organizational commitment to growth.
persistent_gaps: Lack of diversification strategy execution remains the primary gap, leaving the company vulnerable to client concentration risk.
The link between high internal R&D capability and external market adoption needs better operationalization (moving from 'tools' to 'market products').
Supply chain disruptions highlight a continued need for greater resilience planning beyond just inventory management.
achieved_milestones: Completion of the Inventory Digitalization Project.
Successful market validation and launch of multiple new product lines (contributing 18% revenue).
Establishment of a dedicated, high-budget R&D function with structured stage-gate processes.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: The company has moved from merely having a 'formal' innovation program to demonstrating high operational maturity (R&D lab, dedicated budget, structured process). The focus has shifted from basic capability building to aggressive market diversification planning. Digital maturity increased from 3 to 4.
